issue.standard_remedy: Qualify a second source and shift volume
issue.summary: High-risk supplier (score 44) holds 29% of a category

plan.diagnosis: Delta Metals KG represents a concentrated high-risk exposure with USD 6,752,218 in annual spend (29.3% category share) and a risk score of 44, compounded by 1 adverse media event in the past 12 months and low resiliency (score 55). The combination of single-source concentration and elevated supplier risk creates material supply continuity and reputational exposure for the organization.

remedy_steps.step: Immediately launch dual-source qualification process: issue RFI to 3-5 alternative metals suppliers in low-risk geographies (risk score <30) and establish technical qualification timeline of 90 days

Implement enhanced monitoring and mitigation controls: increase Delta Metals KG to weekly risk surveillance, require monthly financial statements, and secure business continuity/buffer stock agreement for critical SKUs
Award trial orders (10-15% of category volume, approximately USD 1,000,000) to qualified alternative supplier(s) and validate quality, delivery, and commercial performance over 6-month pilot
Execute volume rebalancing to reduce Delta Metals KG to <15% category share: shift USD 1,500,000-2,000,000 annualized spend to qualified second source(s) and update sourcing strategy documentation

Conduct root-cause review of adverse media event with Delta Metals KG, require corrective action plan on ESG/compliance gaps (current ESG score 63), and establish quarterly business reviews with escalation triggers

plan.expected_impact: Reduce concentrated supplier risk exposure by USD 1,500,000-2,000,000 through dual-sourcing, decreasing category concentration from 29.3% to below 15% and mitigating supply disruption risk valued at approximately USD 6,752,218.
kpis: Delta Metals KG category share reduced to <15% within 12 months
Qualified second source onboarded and handling 10-15% category volume by month 9
Supplier risk score for metals category portfolio reduced to <35 weighted average
Zero supply disruptions from Delta Metals KG during transition period
Adverse media events for metals suppliers maintained at 0 for newly qualified sources
risks: Delta Metals KG may have proprietary tooling, specifications, or technical capabilities difficult to replicate, extending qualification timeline beyond 90 days
Price premium of 5-15% possible with alternative suppliers due to lower volumes and transition costs, impacting category budget
Quality or delivery issues during pilot phase with new supplier(s) could disrupt production and delay volume shift
Delta Metals KG relationship deterioration during de-sourcing may trigger immediate supply interruption or unfavorable commercial terms
Additional adverse events or financial distress at Delta Metals KG (failure class 1, resiliency 55) during 12-month transition period could force accelerated, unplanned migration
erp_actions: SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for newly qualified alternative suppliers with quota arrangement reducing Delta Metals KG allocation from 100% to 50-60% in metals category material masters
SAP: Flag Delta Metals KG vendor master (LFA1) with risk indicator and implement purchasing value limit of USD 500,000 per PO requiring VP approval for exceptions (release strategy customization)
Coupa: Update supplier risk profile for Delta Metals KG to 'High Risk - Active Mitigation' and enable weekly automated risk monitoring alerts to category team and procurement leadership
Oracle EBS/Dynamics 365/NetSuite: Add approved vendor list (AVL) entries for qualified second sources and update requisition rules to enforce dual-source split for metals category items
SAP: Configure payment terms review for Delta Metals KG to Net 45 (from potential Net 60) to reduce financial exposure and improve cash flow leverage during transition (vendor master LFB1)
All ERPs: Implement spend control reporting dashboard tracking Delta Metals KG monthly spend vs. USD 562,685 target (6,752,218/12 months) with alerts at 110% threshold
